floor: Two absence-vocabulary lists trip together more often than independence allows, which biases the estimate downwards — so it is a floor.
monotone: 78 words fired on 55 entries; that an entry none of them touched is of the kind at a HIGHER rate than one they did would be remarkable.
recall: No screen can show that a further word list would find nothing. Manski's equation (7a) is the same shape.
